# Japan Fude Parcels

Japan field boundaries (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Japanese Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF, 農林水産省). License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/latest/jp.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: geometry, id, land_type_en, admin_local_code, determination:datetime, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/collection.json
